subject: agricultural-science
summary: Short-answer cards with an 'Any 2 of these' list are clean and are the best thing in this subject. Two things drag it down. First, on long-answer cards (2021 HL Q14(c)(iv), 2022 HL Q16(c)(ii)) every tick point repeats the scheme's entire pool of alternatives joined by 'or', so the same 15-line paragraph appears three times and the phone card runs to three screens of near-identical grey text. Second, every card carries a 'Read official question page' attachment, and for plain text questions it opens a full exam page showing other parts and, on at least two cards, a completely different question (Q4 above Q5, Q6 below Q5). Tables are flattened (the Beef HealthCheck report is a run of pipes and ID numbers), figure crops pull in sibling parts with their empty answer boxes, and one card (Mendel passage) cannot be attempted without opening the attachment. Card 10 had no screenshots in the folder and was not visually reviewed.

issues.title: Each tick point repeats the whole pool of alternative answers
issues.detail: On cards 1 and 9 the three tick points each begin with a different lead phrase in black ('Farmer should get fluke tested for resistance', 'dose for all stages of fluke...', 'farmers should dose according to weight') and are then followed by the same grey run of every other acceptable answer joined with 'or' ('or faecal egg sample to determine need ... or dosing in autumn ... or leader follower grazing system -young animals go first ... or Good ventilation ... or quarantine bought in stock'). The identical 15-20 line paragraph appears three times. On the phone the scheme alone is about three full columns of text. Card 9 also has 'aseptic technique)( until it glows red' and '20-30oC' (degree sign lost). Notes such as '3(2): any three recommendations at 2 marks each. The scheme heads part of the pool...' add more shorthand.
issues.suggested_fix: Show one group headed 'Any 3 of these — 2 marks each' (the pattern cards 2, 5 and 7 already use) with each recommendation as its own short tick row, listed once. A crop of the official scheme would also be clearer than this.

issues.title: Attached page shows other questions and parts
issues.detail: The 'Read official question page' reader opens an uncropped exam page even for text-only questions. Card 7 (2020 HL Q5(a)(i)) opens with Question 4 in full at the top, then Q5(a)(ii), (b) and (c). Card 6 (2012 HL Q5(b)(iv)) shows all of Q5 (a), (b)(i)-(iv), (c) and all of Question 6. Card 5 (2012 HL Q1(c)(i)) shows every part (a) to (i) of Q1. Card 2 (2013 OL Q13(a)(ii)) shows Q13(a)(i)-(iv) and Q13(b) with four grass photographs. Card 12 also shows Q13(b) and its pig photograph. The reader's title names the single part ('... — Q5(a)(i)') so the student expects just that part. Only the top of the first page was captured, so anything lower on these pages is additional.
issues.suggested_fix: Drop the attachment entirely when the question is fully typed and has no figure, table or passage (cards 2, 5, 6, 7, 9). Where it is needed, crop the page to this part's region.

issues.title: Data table flattened into pipes and run-on text
issues.detail: Card 1's stem turns the Beef HealthCheck report into one paragraph: 'THE REPORT — Tag | Sex | Age (months) | Carcase (kg) | Liver Score | Lung Score: IE 1234567-8-0001 | E | 20 | 330 | 1 | 3 · IE 1234567-8-0002 | C | 22 | 360 | 3 / 5 | 1 · ...'. It is unreadable as a table on either device and the question ('Using evidence from this report') depends on it. Card 4's kale table is flattened into a sentence too (readable, because it is only two rows) and starts with a stray 'Question 17, part (c)(i).'
issues.suggested_fix: Render the report as a real table (7 rows, 6 columns; horizontally scrollable on phone) or show a crop of the printed report inline, with the score key as two short lists.

issues.title: Figure crops include sibling parts and answer boxes
issues.detail: Card 11's question image is most of the exam page: the 'Section A 100 marks' banner, 'Answer any ten questions', Question 1 heading, part (a) again as print, the two bull photos, then parts (b) and (c) with their blank answer boxes. On the phone the two photographs the student actually needs are only about 150px wide each. Card 8's crop cuts the red A and B labels off at the top edge and carries on down through parts (i) and (ii) with their empty answer grids, ending mid-box.
issues.suggested_fix: Crop to the photographs/diagrams and their letter labels only, at full column width; leave out printed question text and answer boxes.

issues.title: Question cannot be answered from the card
issues.detail: Card 12 (Mendel fill-in) shows only the instruction; the passage with the six numbered gaps and the word list live solely in the attachment, and the stem says 'Use the complete Mendel passage and word list on the official page.' On a phone that means opening the reader and remembering six gaps. The scheme (dominant — Space 1 ...) is clear, but the card is tagged to topic '4.3.2 Production — management' although it is a genetics question.
issues.suggested_fix: Type the passage with numbered blanks and the word list on the card (it is seven lines), or show a crop of just that passage inline.

issues.title: Stems that do not belong, and mark notes that confuse
issues.detail: Card 2 keeps 'Answer any two of the parts (a), (b), (c), (d).' above a single part. Card 9's stem is an editorial sentence, not exam wording ('...so the nitrogen-fixing bacteria in the clover's root nodules were doing part of the fertiliser's work'). Card 11 gives A 5 marks and B 1 mark and puts a description of the photograph under the answer ('Two bulls photographed side by side. A is solid black...'). Card 3 shows 'Shared scale 10 + 6 + 4(1): the first correct answer earns the higher award, whichever part it answers...' plus the raw '(10 + 6 + 4(1))' again, and no marks on any row; its (b) answers are slash-joined. Cards 2, 7, 8 repeat the group heading as 'Any two, 4 marks each (2(4)).' Card 3 also indents (b) further right than (i)-(iii) and runs '(iii) 1. ... 2. ...' on one line.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove section-choice rubrics and editorial stems from part cards; state marks in words ('first correct answer 10, second 6, remaining four 1 each'); drop the duplicate '(2(4))' line and photo descriptions.

good_examples.why: Typed stem and question, 'Any 2 of these — 4 marks each' with six short readable points.
Graph question with five clear 2-mark criteria and helpful one-line notes; its attached page is exactly this part with the table and grid.
One-line question with a five-item 'any 2' list; nothing wasted.
